raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

`VLLMBridgeBackend.build_generation_request` (v2 inference service) builds its vLLM payload without `gconfig.frequency_penalty` and `gconfig.stop`. The sibling `SGLangBridgeBackend` and the v1 `VLLMBackend` both forward them (the v1 backend was fixed for the same omission in #1429), and vLLM's `/v1/completions` and `/v1/chat/completions` endpoints accept both fields. So with the v2 inference service on vLLM, a configured repetition penalty and stop strings are silently ignored, and the same config samples differently depending on the backend.

This adds `frequency_penalty` to the payload, and `stop` when it is set, matching the v1 vLLM backend.

## Related Issue

None found (searched open and closed issues and PRs).

- [x] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable; built with `./docs/build_all.sh`)
- [x] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [ ] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

**Breaking Change Details (if applicable):**

N/A

## Additional Context

The new test `test_vllm_build_generation_request_forwards_frequency_penalty_and_stop` in `tests/v2/inference_service/test_inf_bridge.py` fails on `main` with `KeyError: 'frequency_penalty'` and passes with the fix. `tests/v2/inference_service/test_inf_bridge.py` and `tests/test_vllm_generation_request.py` pass (32 tests, CPU only).

AI use: I used an AI coding assistant (Claude Code) while writing the fix and tests; I reviewed the changes and ran the checks listed above.

         else:
             assert http_req.payload["seed"] == seed
 
+    def test_vllm_build_generation_request_forwards_frequency_penalty_and_stop(
+        self,
+    ):
+        """vLLM bridge forwards frequency_penalty and stop like the SGLang bridge."""
+        backend = VLLMBridgeBackend()
+        req = ModelRequest(
+            input_ids=[11, 12],
+            gconfig=GenerationHyperparameters(
+                max_new_tokens=7, frequency_penalty=0.5, stop=["STOP"]
+            ),
+        )
+
+        http_req = backend.build_generation_request(req, with_lora=False, version=0)
+
+        assert http_req.payload["frequency_penalty"] == 0.5
+        assert http_req.payload["stop"] == ["STOP"]
